title: ALL MY EX'S LIVE IN TEXAS
lyrics_plain:
Dick Anderson
All my ex's live in Texas
And Texas is a place   I'd dearly love to be
But all my ex's live in Texas
And that's why I hang my hat in Tennessee
Rosanna's down in Texarcana
wanted me to push her broom
And sweet Ilene's   in Abilene
she forgot   I hung the moon
And Allison in Galveston
somehow lost her sanity
And Dimples who now lives in Temple's
Got the law now lookin' for me
All my ex's live in Texas
And Texas is a place   I'd dearly love to be
But all my ex's live in Texas
And that's why I hang my hat in Tennessee
I remember that old Frio river
where I learned to swim
And it brings to mind   another time
where I wore my welcome thin
My transcendental meditation
I go there each night
But I always come back to myself
Long before daylight
That's because   All my ex's live in Texas
And Texas is a place   I'd dearly love to be
But all my ex's live in Texas
And that's why I hang my hat in Tennessee
And that's why I hang my hat in Tennessee
